title: Parallel classification (cls) vs. per-step autoregressive (step_ar) vs. full-trace autoregressive (ar)
question: Across the two controlled steps from cls to ar—first replacing ParallelClassificationHead with sequential SubspaceLMHead predictions while keeping the per-step harness (cls vs. step_ar), then removing external state rewriting so the full trace stays in context (step_ar vs. ar)—how do convergence speed, in-domain accuracy, and zero-shot base and length transfer compare?
